entities.name: Otto Wächter
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Baron Otto Gustav von Wächter was an Austrian lawyer, Nazi politician and high-ranking member of the SS, a paramilitary organisation of the Nazi Party. He participated in the extermination of Jews in Europe during the Holocaust and was instrumental in creating an SS division consisting of Ukrainians.
